men.summary: Two games into the 2026-27 season, the Bluejays are 2-0 with a perfect home slate, having beaten Kansas City 76-61 and Le Moyne 83-55 by a combined 43 points. With Big East play still ahead, no Quadrant 1 games yet, and a NET ranking of 83 (despite a stronger-looking RPI of 32), it's far too early to project the postseason, though a strong conference showing would be needed to build an at-large résumé.

women.summary: The Bluejays opened 2026-27 at 1-0 with a 73-71 road win at South Dakota State on Nov 2, which counts as a Quadrant 1 victory and has them on a 1W streak. With a NET ranking of 91 and a No. 1 RPI that reflects only one game, their postseason outlook is still undefined, and it will depend on how they handle Big East play, where they're 0-0.
